prompt: Create a standalone responsive accessible profitability results table component. Its input shape must be structurally compatible with the accepted DTO fields AgrupacionId, Agrupacion, Nombre, Venta, Costo, UtilidadBruta, IncluyeDescuentoEncabezadoEnUtilidad and Semantica. Include loading/empty/error-safe presentation but do not calculate or display margin percentage and do not fabricate header-discount allocation. No HTTP, route or backend changes.
